note: Session-replay scripts Nosy recognises. Each entry is a script whose job is recording visits, sourced from the vendor's own documentation. kind recorder: the vendor's main product records sessions, so its tag counts. kind addon: recording is an optional part of a broader tool, so only the recording-specific file counts, matched by path. Survey, A/B, personalization and plain analytics tools are not here, and neither is the tracker data's replay label.
